description: Create a NEW version of the Generalist Gripper assembly used with SO-101 Arm 2 / Mount 2. Relocate servo, drive gears and as much supporting hardware as feasible UP ABOVE the human hand/finger plane, separating the drivetrain plane from the gripper finger plane. Preserve geared actuation, useful opening/stroke, and real servo/horn/fastener interfaces. Use vertical shafts/posts or another justified transmission arrangement to reach the fingers, minimize obstructions in their plane, and check full motion plus screw/tool/cable access. Coordinate with other HelpingHands worker before editing shared catalog or version registry. Use GPT-6.1 Sol medium.
